senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; חוּל I) [surrounding, protection,] army.—Pl. חֲיָילִים, חֲיָילוֹת. Mekh. B’shall. s. 1. Ib., Shirah, s. 3. Ib. 4 לספק אכסניות לכל חֲיָילוֹתָיו to provide pay for all his troops.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 48:6">Midr. Till. to Ps. XLVIII, 14</cite> (ref. to <he>לחֵילָה</he> <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 48:6">ib.</cite> = <he>לחֵילָהּ</he>) <he>לחֲיָילוֹתֶיהָ וכ׳</he> to her (Jerusalem’s) hosts that shall enter it (as pilgrims); a. fr.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 54:4">Gen. R. s. 54</cite> <he>יישר חֵילְכֶם</he> may your strength be confirmed (I thank you)!; Midr. Sam. ch. XII <he>חֵילֵיכֶם</he>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 103">Yalk. Sam. 103</cite> <he>חֵילֵיכֶן</he>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:4">Num. R. s. 10</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 31:3">Prov. XXXI, 3</cite>) <he>זה חֵילָהּ של תורה</he> that is the strength which the Law gives.—<he>בְּרוֹר חַ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="B01209"><he>בְּרוֹר</he></cite>
